files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path

grains.fy: fiscal year; rate = method B (year to date over its published months when partial, not annualized)
grains.t12: the 12 months ending at period_last_month, from the entity's 12th month; rate = method A
grains.admin: an administration's whole window (Trump II so far); rate annualized x 12 / months
grains.admin_n: months 1..N in office for every administration, N = admin_n_months (the open administration's months so far); rate annualized as admin

dimension_roles: rated: count, headcount and rate per 100 of the value's mean headcount; unknown: counts and headcount only, no rate; every dimension's values, unknown included, partition departures and headcount

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'fy' (fiscal year), 't12' (the 12 months ending at period_last_month), 'admin' (an administration's whole window) or 'admin_n' (its months 1..N in office, N = admin_n_months); never month or quarter (spec section 9)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'FYyyyy' at fy grain; 'YYYY-MM' (the window's last month) at t12 grain; the administration id (meta administrations) at admin and admin_n grain; the key into the period table

columns.name: value
columns.description: value code within the dimension (meta dimensions: order and role); labels are copy, pending sign-off

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective in the window with this value (transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_quit
columns.description: departures with separation code SC; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_retirement
columns.description: departures with separation code SD + SE + SG; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_rif
columns.description: departures with separation code SH; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_termination
columns.description: departures with separation code SJ; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_other
columns.description: departures with separation code SL; the six categories partition departures

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: departures with drp_indicator = 'Y', any code: an overlay on the six categories

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: rows with this value in the employment file of the period's period_last_month; null in a share dimension (no on-board count exists for those groups)

columns.name: rate_num
columns.description: departures in the window with this value (admin and admin_n grains: x 12 / rate_months, annualized); rate = rate_num / rate_den; null for an unknown value, a structural zero or a share dimension

columns.name: rate_den
columns.description: mean month-end headcount with this value over the window's published months (fy: method B, year to date when partial; t12: method A); null for an unknown value or a share dimension, and null (never 0) when that mean is 0

columns.name: rate_months
columns.description: number of month-end headcounts averaged into rate_den (also set on a structural zero)

columns.name: rate_small_base
columns.description: rate_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when there is no rate

columns.name: rate_not_applicable
columns.description: structural zero: nobody with this value on board in any month of the window, so no rate (never a small-base flag); null for an unknown value or a share dimension

columns.name: coverage
columns.description: share of the window's departures whose value for this dimension is known (not the unknown value); null when there are none

period_columns.name: fiscal_year
period_columns.description: fiscal year of the period (of its last month at t12 grain); null at admin grains

period_columns.name: period_first_month
period_columns.description: first calendar month of the window (YYYY-MM), published or not

period_columns.name: period_last_month
period_columns.description: last published month of the window within the entity's span: the month stocks are taken from

period_columns.name: months_in_period
period_columns.description: months in the full window: 12; admin grain: the administration's published months (Trump II so far); admin_n grain: N

period_columns.name: months_published
period_columns.description: months of the window with a published employment file within the entity's span

period_columns.name: provisional
period_columns.description: the window contains any of the newest 3 months (invariant 8)

period_columns.name: partial
period_columns.description: a fiscal year with months not yet published or outside the entity's span; at admin grains, an administration still in office (Trump II) or a window cut by the entity's span

period_columns.name: reissued
period_columns.description: a month of the window changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json)

period_columns.name: opm_incomplete
period_columns.description: a month of the window OPM marks incomplete for this entity (KDI-006)

period_columns.name: kdi_ids
period_columns.description: known data issue ids touching a month of the window: entity-month flags, plus the ids of length-of-service values treated as unknown on the cube's action rows (KDI-001, KDI-009, KDI-010)
